summary.one_liner: Web3GPT is an AI agent app that writes, compiles, deploys, pins and verifies Solidity smart contracts on EVM chains from plain-language requests.
summary.what_it_does: The agent turns a plain-language description into Solidity, picks a solc compiler matching the contract's pragma (0.4.11 and later, checksum-verified), and deploys it to a supported EVM chain. Sources, ABI, bytecode and standard JSON input are pinned to IPFS via Pinata, and a background cron job queues verification on Blockscout or Etherscan. Users can chat in the browser, deploy with their own wallet through RainbowKit, or create custom agents with their own instructions and share them by link. A public HTTP skill API (POST /api/skill) lets other agents or scripts hold conversations, including deployments, without an account. The README lists supported chains (Polygon mainnet for agent deploys only, plus several Sepolia testnets) and describes per-IP and per-deployment rate limits.
use_cases: deploy an ERC-20 or NFT contract from a text description
generate and compile Solidity with the correct solc version
let an AI agent deploy smart contracts via an HTTP API
verify contracts on Blockscout or Etherscan
pin contract sources and metadata to IPFS
deploy contracts to testnets from a browser chat
notable: Agent-to-agent skill API (POST /api/skill) that works without an account
Chooses the Solidity compiler version from each contract's pragma
Pins sources, ABI, bytecode and standard JSON input to IPFS
Users can choose agent-paid deployment or deploy with their own wallet
caveats: Agent deployments are rate-limited (e.g. 10 testnet deploys per caller per hour; 2 per day on Polygon mainnet)
Self-hosting needs many services: OpenAI key, Upstash Redis, funded EVM key, Pinata account, GitHub OAuth app
Built for Vercel; verification depends on a cron job and API routes up to 300s
